subject: reasoning
question: Length of 5 rectangles J, K, L, M and N is compared. Length of no two rectangles is same. Length of K is less than only three rectangles. Length of no rectangle is less than M. Length of L is not more than N but more than J. Length of how many rectangles is less than L?
solution:
**Given:** Length of 5 rectangles J, K, L, M and N is compared. Length of no two rectangles is same.

1. Length of no rectangle is less than M.

__ > __ > __ > __ > M

2. Length of K is less than only three rectangles.

__ > __ > __
